headline: Federal attention on data-center water reuse
summary: A national water-reuse incentive discussion creates a relevant policy signal for Arizona because cooling method, water source, and reuse commitments are increasingly central to data-center review.

headline: ACC large-load workshop establishes grid-planning signal
summary: ACC materials frame data centers as large-load users whose integration into the grid requires cost-allocation and resource-planning scrutiny.

headline: Tucson planning review highlights water, energy, noise, and public-process variables
summary: Tucson's draft approach creates a useful model for what data-center transparency could look like in city-level planning.

headline: Project Baccara moves through county process despite opposition
summary: The West Valley project is a real-time test of how Arizona balances economic development, power generation, environmental concerns, and community response.
